title: Abdominal Symptoms and Rosacea: An Observational Study on the Association Between Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) and the Gut-Skin Axis
official: Sintomi Addominali e RosaceA: Studio Osservazionale Sull'Associazione Tra Sindrome Dell'Intestino Irritabile (IBS) e l'Asse Intestino-pelle
summary: To describe the prevalence of rosacea in a population of patients with IBS followed at a tertiary-level university medical center.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18 years
* Evaluation at the Internal Medicine, Digestive Physiopathology, and Dermatology outpatient clinics of the IRCCS AOU Policlinico di Sant'Orsola in Bologna within the last 12 months.
* Presence of a confirmed diagnosis of IBS and/or rosacea documented in the outpatient medical record.
* Availability of clinical data essential for the analysis.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \<18 years.
* Unable to confirm the presence of IBS and/or rosacea.
* Insufficient clinical data for analysis.
